title: Make claimable-work projection terminal-evidence-aware
problem: Fresh /wc allocation currently observes static queue/seed READY or legacy CLAIMED states that can be older than terminal RETURN/DONE evidence. This forces workers to spend repeated reads excluding already-completed work and can trigger unsafe fake recovery if old claims are treated as live truth.
mission: Compile a current claimable-work projection from queue/seed intent plus live pins, claims, runs and returns, giving newer terminal evidence and active deterministic ownership precedence over stale static labels. Emit explicit exclusion reasons and keep the projection non-authoritative.
acceptance: Claimable-work projection filters terminal returns and completed runs before presenting READY or recoverable work.
Stale seed or queue labels are treated as historical inputs rather than current availability when newer terminal evidence exists.
Allocator emits machine-auditable exclusion reasons for TERMINAL_RETURN, ACTIVE_PIN, CAPABILITY_BOUNDARY and STALE_PROJECTION.
Tests cover at least: static READY plus terminal RETURN, legacy CLAIMED plus terminal RETURN/DONE, active portfolio PIN, nonterminal BOUNDARY/PARTIAL and capability-bound work.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served, Catalog or /w authority is promoted by projection cleanup.

goal_relevance.reason: Fresh identical /wc workers should spend cycles on executable work rather than disproving stale queue labels.

information_gain.reason: Turns implicit multi-source precedence into explicit machine-auditable claimability state.

regression_prevention.reason: Prevents old CLAIMED/READY projections from reopening completed work or misleading stale recovery.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Workers can allocate correctly without human triage or repeated archaeology.

candidate_write_scope: tests for terminal-return and active-pin precedence
falsification: A live generated allocator already filters terminal RETURN/DONE and active PINs before exposing claimable work, and the stale labels observed here are never consumed by workers.
The old O-SWARM-KERNEL-IMPLEMENT-V1 READY/CLAIMED state is already reliably shadowed by a canonical fresh projection at the actual /wc allocation point.
Adding another projection would create a second conflicting authority instead of a read-only derived view.

source_freshness.observation: Allocation observed static READY/CLAIMED work with newer terminal return evidence, static portfolio seeds with DONE/SUPERSEDED returns, and active deterministic PINs that had to be rediscovered before avoiding duplicate execution.
